name: Dynamics 365 Knowledge Management
short_description: Knowledge management in Dynamics 365 Customer Service gives support teams one place to create, review, approve, publish, search and improve help articles for agents and self-service customers.

evidence.quote: That's where Dynamics 365 Knowledge Management comes in.
And your knowledge base is yet another separate tool.
